title: Virtual Compute: regional rate multiplier
content:
## Meaning — regional rate multiplier

Virtual Compute regional rate multiplier: Map from service region to multiplicative usage rate factor; decimal mapping.

## Tier values — regional rate multiplier

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — regional rate multiplier: US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — regional rate multiplier: US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — regional rate multiplier: US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — regional rate multiplier: US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — regional rate multiplier: US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — regional rate multiplier: US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for regional rate multiplier?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has regional rate multiplier of US East: 1.0; US West: 1.04; EU West: 1.12.
